name: Recital C
title: Resolution on the deteriorating situation of women in Afghanistan due to the recent adoption of the law on the “Promotion of Virtue and Prevention of Vice”
part_text: ‘whereas a recent Taliban decree, the so-called Law on Propagation of Virtue and Prevention of Vice, extends these restrictions by even requiring that female voices not be heard in public, thus further depriving Afghan women of their fundamental rights and freedoms,’
